segments.heading: Prerequisites
segments.text:
- A usable remote control, a normal display screen
- A usable WiFi network, WiFi antenna, and a WiFi module built into the device

segments.heading: Operation steps
segments.text:
1. Connect the device to the display screen, connect the WiFi antenna (if you don't know the location, refer to the "Interface Status Definition" column above), and power on the device.
2. Use the remote control ENTER to enter the device network settings menu, press the confirmation key and press the direction key to select WiFi mode, and confirm to save.
